basic_details.job_title: BMC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 42 X-ray Assistant, Laboratory Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital and Medical College (LTMG Hospital), Sion, Mumbai, run by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, is filling 42 posts on a purely contract basis: X-ray Assistant, Laboratory Technician, Neurology Technician, Physiotherapist, Dialysis Technician, Laboratory Assistant, E.C.G. Technician and Occupational Therapist. The filled application, with the original fee receipt of Rs. 1027 and the qualification documents, must be submitted at the hospital's inward/outward department by 5:30 PM on 2 December 2026. Applications received by post are not considered

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to submit the fully filled application, with all documents of educational qualification and the original fee receipt attached, at the inward/outward department of LTMG Hospital by 5:30 PM on 02-12-2026. The notice states that applications received by post will not be considered, and that applications submitted or received at the office or anywhere else after 02.12.2026 will not be considered. The application is addressed to the Dean, Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Medical College and General Hospital, Sion, Mumbai - 400022. The notice prints the form with the telephone numbers 02224066381-89 / 022 28541017-18. The notice gives no email address for sending applications, and no subject line or envelope wording. The fee is paid first. It is paid at the Cashier Department (Room No. 15), Ground Floor, College Building, LTMG Hospital, from 25.11.2026 to 02.12.2026, during office hours from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays are excluded. The original receipt must be attached, and an application without the receipt will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay for each post is a lump-sum honorarium per month. The contract period is 15.12.2026 to 31.03.2027. The notice prints no category-wise break-up of these vacancies. No DA, HRA or any other allowance is payable besides the lump-sum honorarium. All posts: the age of the candidate must not be more than 38 years. The notice prints no relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age. The candidate must have passed the full-time 3-year degree course BPMT (Bachelor of Paramedical Technology in Radiography) run through the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences after 12th, and completed a 6-month internship; OR B.Sc. in Physics from a recognised university and 2 years' experience in the X-ray department of a hospital; OR 12th + Diploma in Radiography, and 2 years' experience in an X-ray department. The candidate must also pass the Trade Test conducted by the Municipal Corporation's department. B.Sc. degree from a recognised university and a diploma (MSBT)/D.M.L.T. (B.Sc.+ D.M.L.T.); OR After 12th, a degree of Bachelor of Paramedical Technology in Laboratory Medicine from the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences. The candidate must have passed the full-time 3-year degree course BPMT (Bachelor of Paramedical Technology-Neurology) run through the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, and completed a 12-month internship. B.Sc (PT) / B.P.Th. (Bachelor of Physiotherapy) degree from a recognised university. Registration with the Maharashtra State Occupational Therapy and Physiotherapy Council, Mumbai. B.Sc. in Dialysis Technology from a recognised university OR 12th passed with a 1 year / 6 months certificate course in Dialysis Technology. B.Sc. degree from a recognised university with Chemistry, Microbiology, Biochemistry or Biotechnology as the main subject. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The fully filled application form and the Bio-data form. The original receipt of the application fee. All documents of educational qualification. The form itself says "certified copies of certificates". A marriage registration certificate or the gazette notice of a change of name, where applicable. A married woman without these may apply in her pre-marriage name. If previously punished, the details of the punishment and a certified copy of the court decision. A character certificate from the concerned police station must be submitted before a contract appointment is given to an eligible candidate; it is not an enclosure for the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes the selection in the following steps: A merit list is prepared from the prescribed educational qualification and the marks obtained in the interview. The selection list is prepared from the candidates in the merit list. The place, date and time of the interview are informed two days in advance by email, to the email ID given in the application. A valid email ID in the application is therefore required. Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost. The Trade Test applies to X-ray Assistant, Laboratory Assistant and E.C.G. Technician, as printed in their rows. The notice does not give its date or syllabus.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Before applying, candidates must satisfy themselves that they meet the qualifications and conditions of the post they apply for. The mobile number, email ID and correspondence address (with PIN code) in the application must be clear and complete. A candidate who has been convicted by a court in a case involving moral turpitude or a criminal case, or who has a police inquiry or court case pending, must give that information. False information, false documents or concealed information at any time after the selection process begins or after appointment cancels the candidature or ends the appointment without notice. BMC has not authorised anyone to sell or accept application forms. The Dean, LTMG Hospital, may stop the selection process at any stage for administrative or other reasons.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Contract Appointment
content_sections.text: The engagement is strictly on contract. The appointee cannot claim a right to permanent service in the Corporation or any regular service benefits. A one-day break in service is given before every 90 days of the contract service. An agreement on Rs. 500 bond paper is taken at the time of appointment. Weekly off follows the sessions of the department to which the appointee is posted. Three casual leaves are allowed for January 2027 to March 2027, and no other leave. Biometric attendance must be marked daily according to duty hours. Absence without permission is treated as leave without pay (LWP). Work must be done in three shifts in any department of LTMG Hospital and Medical College, Sion. The Dean, LTMG Hospital, may end the contract without prior notice if the work is not satisfactory. Disciplinary action found during the contract cancels the appointment immediately. A selected candidate who wishes to resign for any reason must give one month's notice. As the appointment is on contract, the appointee cannot approach any court.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the BMC LTMG Hospital contract recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 42 posts across eight posts: X-ray Assistant 11, Laboratory Technician 2, Neurology Technician 2, Physiotherapist 1, Dialysis Technician 11, Laboratory Assistant 12, E.C.G. Technician 1 and Occupational Therapist 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must be submitted at the hospital's inward/outward department by 5:30 PM on 2 December 2026. Applications submitted or received after 02.12.2026 are not considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Dialysis Technician?
faq.answer: The qualification is a B.Sc. in Dialysis Technology from a recognised university, or 12th pass with a 1 year / 6 months certificate course in Dialysis Technology. The Marathi and computer certificate conditions for all posts also apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate must not be more than 38 years. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay for each post?
faq.answer: It is a lump-sum honorarium per month. X-ray Assistant and Laboratory Assistant get Rs. 16000, Laboratory Technician, Neurology Technician, Dialysis Technician and E.C.G. Technician get Rs. 20000, and Physiotherapist and Occupational Therapist get Rs. 40000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 870 + 18% GST Rs. 157 = Rs. 1027. It is non-refundable under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the fee paid and can the application be sent by post?
faq.answer: The fee is paid at the Cashier Department (Room No. 15), Ground Floor, College Building, LTMG Hospital, from 25.11.2026 to 02.12.2026, 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM on working days. Applications by post are not considered.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A merit list is prepared from the prescribed qualification and the marks obtained in the interview, and the selection list is made from it. The interview details are sent by email two days before.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract, from 15.12.2026 to 31.03.2027. Appointees cannot claim a right to permanent service in the Corporation or any regular service benefits.

faq.question: Q10. Are DA and HRA paid in addition to the honorarium?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no dearness allowance, house rent allowance or similar allowance is payable besides the lump-sum honorarium.
